Carla M.: quick q — Payments team requested an exclusive ~30m window for a DB maintenance. Can we swap Tue 11:00 slot with Wed 09:00? Also need a smoke owner for the paired deploys. who can pair with Payments and own smoke?
Miguel R.: I can pair Tue 11:00 but I have to step out at 11:45. is 45m enough for smoke + quick rollback?
Sam K.: we have a tiny model rollout Wed 09:00 (no migration). nothing heavy, can slide to Fri if that helps. prefer not to block Payments.
Priya S.: if we swap, I can own smoke for the Payments + paired deploy. checklist I run: db connection sanity, 95th latency < 120ms, example flows, and a small traffic ramp.
Carla M.: sweet — thanks Priya. Miguel can you confirm rollback points for your change? we should mark a safe tag + schema rollback plan.
Miguel R.: rollback points: tag v1.8.2 before migration. migration is reversible (downgrade script exists) but needs short downtime. will push migration PR with explicit rollback section.
Ben T.: ping on CR for the migration: https://git.redwood.dev/payments/merge/412 — left 2 comments about index ordering. once addressed i can approve.
Alice L.: deploy-bot FYI — blocked slots: Tue 11:00 = payments-maint, Wed 09:00 = model-rollout.
deploy-bot: slot-update: Tue 2024-05-07T11:00 booked by payments-maintenance, Wed 2024-05-08T09:00 freed (model-rollout moved). (automated)
Priya S.: proposed smoke steps (short form):
1) run smoke script against canary host
2) validate 3 user journeys, 2qps for 5m
3) check errors < 1% and no DB connection failures
4) thumbs up -> promote

Command I use:
```
./smoke-run --env prod --canary --checks db-connections,latency,api-flows --timeout 600
```

Carla M.: timeline suggestion:
- Tue 10:30 — pre-deploy sync (owners on call)
- Tue 11:00 — Payments deploy + paired services (Miguel + Payments lead)
- Tue 11:10 — canary traffic (Priya runs smoke)
- Tue 11:30 — decision window (promote or rollback)

Sam K.: ok with that timeline. i'll move our model rollout to Fri in the train manifest.
Ben T.: once migration CR updated, tagging and a short rollback doc in PR will make approvals fast. i'll queue smoke run steps as a checklist in the PR.
Miguel R.: will update PR and add downgrade script link. aim to have everything green by EOD Monday.
Carla M.: perfect. i'll update the release train manifest and ping this thread once slots are swapped. thanks all :raised_hands:
Priya S.: noted — i'll be the smoke owner Tue 11:00. will post results here as soon as checks finish.
deploy-bot: reminder scheduled — Tue 11:00: Payments maintenance & paired deploys. 24h reminder sent.
Carla M.: closing loop: swapped slots in the manifest and added smoke owner tag. leaving this thread open for any last-minute changes — ping me if you need to trade again :thumbsup:
